d: For a few seasons, questions have followed Kylian Mbappe and Vinicius Junior at Real Madrid. Could two superstars who prefer operating from the left flank really share the spotlight? The debate has only grown during Vinicius' difficult run of form, but the Champions League clash against PSV offered a different picture. Mbappe's decision to hand his Player of the Match award to Vinicius was a powerful show of support between two players expected to lead Real Madrid's attack. Rupha Ramani dives deep into the Mbappe-Vinicius relationship and whether the two stars are finally finding a way to…
